recoveryFollowThrough.cause: Windows OS Trash changes ctime of the remaining alias when moving another hardlink; native diagnostic run37148365749 retained all other stat fields unchanged. Strict guard refused cleanup after the first move.
recoveryFollowThrough.fix: Only aliases of the moved inode may differ in ctime; require every other signature field and pre/post SHA256 bytes to match. Read64KiB chunks; validate file descriptor/path metadata around hashing. All other checks stay strict.
